images.prompt: Close-up of the rear bumper of a dark grey saloon car with a clear horizontal dent and scraped paint across the bumper, boot lid straight and undamaged.
Wide shot of the rear three-quarter view of the same dark grey saloon car in a car park, showing the dented rear bumper and an intact rear light cluster.
Close-up of a very light scuff and shallow paint scratch on the front passenger door of a silver hatchback. The damage is cosmetic and minor, no dents, panel perfectly straight.
Wide side view of the same silver hatchback parked on a residential street, bodywork straight and clean apart from one small scuff on the front passenger door.
Front end of a silver estate car after a collision: crumpled bonnet, cracked front bumper, broken left headlight, radiator grille pushed inward.
Bonnet and roof of a blue saloon car covered in many small round hail dents, photographed from a high angle so the dimples catch the light.
Close-up through the windscreen of a car showing a long crack spreading from a stone chip on the passenger side of the glass.
